Commentary.Commentary: West Indies were pretty good with their over rate but couldn't do much apart from that. They failed to get wickets at regular intervals on a pitch which looked good to bat on. Bishoo got three wickets yesterday, mainly due to the batsmen playing poor shots. Gabriel looked threatening but didn't do enough justice. Kraigg Brathwaite got some cheap wickets towards the end as India were looking to score quick runs. So let's see how West Indies respond now. India have about 16 overs to bowl at. Join us back in a bit for the hosts' reply.

West Indies will be relieved finally as India have declared. Terrific performance by India. They lost Vijay early on but Dhawan batted beautifully. The southpaw looked all set for a ton but unfortunately got out on 84. Pujara and Rahane didn't impress much but the partnership between Virat Kohli and Ravichandran Ashwin was the highlight of the innings. The captain smashed his first double ton whereas the offie hit his third Test century. Saha and Mishra were handy with the bat as well as India crossed the 550-run mark. India would be pretty pleased with their efforts.
